features.feature: Three-panel folding mattress with broad rectangular panels, shown flat or folded into an A-shaped profile.
Plain, smooth dark navy fabric on the top surfaces of all three panels.
Blue side fabric with a repeating light blue and tan angular geometric pattern.
Narrow dark piping outlines the panel edges and joins.
Narrow navy fabric tabs with small metal eyelets extend from the side edge.
Orange rectangular label with a fine white border and white lettering.
features.where: Long patterned side, near one end
